description: REFINEMENT RUNG (scratchpad/HANDWRITING_DESIGN.md's 'REFINEMENT RUNG' section, the Omniglot residual, commit 26f74039): the Omniglot gate found recognition was exact quantized-signature match at ONE grain (turn_bins=16), so +-1-bin non-uniform jitter -> 81% held-out OOV despite LEARN saturation PASS. domains/ink_decode.py's decode_ink now recognizes a span at a COARSE grain when the FINE grain fails ('tolerance = COARSENESS, not fuzzy matching -- coarse-grain exact match IS the principled near-miss band'); when that happens, THIS seed decides whether the fine mismatch is confined to ONE dimension (turn or len) and, if so, WHICH -- a per-dimension CHILD quantum refines the coarse family (refines_quantum edge), mirroring seeds/shape_decode_loop.json's sd_mint_quantum pattern exactly: the RULE decides, domains/ink_decode.py (_refine_or_note) only INSTALLS what it decided (stroke_codebook.grow_stroke_refinement_quantum). domains/ink_decode.py computes the two mechanical FACTS these rules read (turn_all_match / len_all_match -- a fixed structural comparison of two ALREADY-QUANTIZED relation-lists whose IDENTITY a held Term already decided upstream, never a Python ranking) and writes them onto a fresh, single-use RefinementObservation node wired agent -refines-> obs (the SAME 'ag'-hub convention shape_decode_loop.json's Observation nodes use, agent -observed-> obs) before calling run_rules(). Exactly one of the three ir_* rules below can ever match a given RefinementObservation (their guards partition {turn_all_match, len_all_match} x {true,false} minus the (true,true) case, which domains/ink_decode.py never even creates an Observation for -- nothing to refine when both already match). No new Rust Terms; Term-free rules (plain set_attr effects) in the SAME style as seeds/shape_decode_loop.json's sd_dim_check_mark.

microtheory.name: ink_refinement
microtheory.description: per-dimension refinement-child minting for a coarse-recognized stroke span whose fine grain does not exact-match its family

rules.name: ir_mint_turn_child
rules.comment: The fine mismatch is confined to TURN quanta ONLY (len_q matched everywhere) -- design: 'a fine mismatch confined to turn quanta mints a turn-only child'. Guard: status pending, turn_all_match==false, len_all_match==true. Effect is a PLAIN set_attr (Term-free, mirrors sd_dim_check_mark's style) -- the actual quantum INSTALL is domains/ink_decode.py's job (grow_stroke_refinement_quantum), reading this status back exactly like sd_mint_quantum's 'minted' edge is read by stroke_codebook.grow_stroke_quantum's OOV-path caller.

rules.name: ir_mint_len_child
rules.comment: The fine mismatch is confined to LEN quanta ONLY (turn_q matched everywhere) -- design: '... len likewise'. Guard: status pending, turn_all_match==true, len_all_match==false.

rules.name: ir_mint_both_child
rules.comment: BOTH turn and len mismatch (the coarse family was right but neither fine dimension held) -- the codebook still becomes a refinement tree (design: 'the codebook becomes a refinement TREE'), tagged refined_dim='both' rather than falling all the way back to a wholly independent top-level OOV quantum (the coarse recognition already established the family). Guard: status pending, turn_all_match==false, len_all_match==false. (The (true,true) combination -- both already match -- never reaches this seed at all: domains/ink_decode.py's _refine_or_note returns early ('exact_at_fine') without ever creating a RefinementObservation for it, so no fourth rule is needed.)
